nrIncident.message:
A broken down freight train between Nottingham and Newark Castle means the line is disrupted. Trains running between Nottingham and Lincoln may be cancelled or revised.
Disruption is expected until 07:30.
Customer advice:
There is a broken down freight train between Nottingham and Newark Castle. This will disrupt trains on the Matlock / Derby / Nottingham / Cleethorpes and Crewe / Derby/ Nottingham / Lincoln routes, as well as two early morning services that run between Lincoln Central and London St Pancras International.
Another train is now in place to help move the broken down freight train. Once these trains are attached together and safety checks have been completed, the broken down train will be moved out of the way.
How does this affect my train?
Trains running through the area between Nottingham and Newark Castle / Lincoln are currently unable to run, until the broken down train is moved.
Some of our trains running through the area between Lincoln Central and Nottingham, will also be unable to run. This is due to where the trains and train crew are located.
At present we are expecting the problem to be fixed in the next 2 hours. As soon as the problem is fixed the priority will be to get trains running to their advertised times again. We expect the advertised timetable to resume on the affected routes by 07:30.
How do I get where I need to be?
Please check your journey before travel this morning on the affected routes, we will have some alterations and cancellations to our services and journey times will be extended by up to 60 minutes.
If you are travelling from Nottingham to Lincoln, you can use your existing ticket to travel at no extra cost via Sleaford.
If you are travelling to or from stations between Nottingham and Lincoln, and need advice on how to complete your journey please speak to a member of station staff, use the help points or you can contact us on X (formerly Twitter).
If you are due to travel between Lincoln and London, you can use your ticket at no extra cost to travel on the LNER 07:30 Lincoln to London Kings Cross service, or on EMR services to Newark North Gate or Peterborough and then LNER services from Newark North Gate and Peterborough.
